'''Relay beacons''' were small flashing devices used to mark pathways. The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] used relay beacons on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] to not get lost in the planet's snowy wastes.
